confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregator and guide figures, several dated 2025 or undated, with few data points per venue type, so they are indicative. Wine and cocktail are cross-checked against beer and Stockholm guides. SEK to USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 9.5 SEK per USD, not a looked-up rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on inspected listings, so they are low confidence. The FX observation was taken from search-result excerpts of the RBA exchange rates page, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gothenburg-specific basis: restaurant lunch and dinner figures from Numbeo-derived and Expatistan aggregators, beer and cocktail ranges from Expatistan, Citiesinsider and Euro City Guide, and a cappuccino figure from a Swedish price-comparison site (nearby city, Helsingborg). Wine uses a Stockholm guide range and a Gothenburg mid-range venue range. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Gothenburg's summer demand; no accommodation search was performed.
